desc:
SEO migration for a new platform or URLs protects your search traffic when your store moves or page addresses change. Ecom Swift LLC maps every important old page to its new address and checks the new site so search engines and visitors arrive in the right place.

## Why does SEO migration care matter when you change platform?

SEO migration care matters because search engines remember your old addresses. When a page moves and nothing tells them where, the old address shows an error, the link value built over time is lost and visitors land on a dead page. A platform move that looks fine on screen can quietly remove a large share of your search visibility.

The risk is highest on stores, since they carry many product and collection addresses, plus images, filters and old blog posts that people still link to.

## What goes wrong without a plan

Typical damage follows a pattern. Product addresses change with the new platform and are not redirected. Titles and descriptions are blank on the new site. The sitemap still lists old pages. Noindex tags from the testing stage stay on after launch, which tells search engines to ignore the whole store.

Each of these is easy to prevent before launch and slow to repair after. Search engines may take a long time to relearn a site, and during that period sales from search can drop.

## How migration care protects revenue

Redirects tell search engines that a page has moved and send shoppers straight to the matching new page. Pre-launch checks confirm that titles, tags and sitemaps survived the move. Monitoring after launch catches errors before they spread.

The result is a shorter and smoother recovery period, and fewer lost visitors in between. How much traffic changes still depends on the new site's design, speed and content, and on how search engines respond, so we do not promise that rankings will hold. We reduce avoidable loss.

## What a safe migration includes

- A full inventory of important old pages, products, collections and posts.
- A redirect map pairing each old address with its best new match.
- Testing of redirects on a staging copy, where one exists.
- A check that titles, headings and meta descriptions carried over.
- Verification that noindex and robots settings are correct at launch.
- A fresh sitemap submitted for the new site.
- Image address and internal link checks.
- Search Console set up on the new property.
- A launch day review and a short period of monitoring.

## How we work alongside your team

We work with your developer or platform team, not in place of them. We begin with the inventory, using a crawl and your analytics to find the pages that earn visits or links. We rank these so the pages that matter most receive the most care.

The Basic package covers the inventory and redirect map for a small store, with a checklist for your developer. The Standard package adds redirects tested, titles, tags and sitemap checks on the new site, a launch day check and Search Console setup. The Premium package covers large sites, tests the redirect map on staging, checks internal links and image addresses, monitors after launch and ends with a final report.

If you want us to complete the platform move itself, that is separate work. Add-ons include more pages mapped, image redirects and a later check.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Involve us before the new site is built, not after it launches.
- Keep the old site live and untouched until redirects are tested.
- Preserve page titles and key text where possible.
- Redirect each old page to the closest new match.
- Check Search Console daily in the first weeks.

**Avoid:**
- Sending every old address to the new home page.
- Launching on a Friday evening with nobody watching.
- Leaving the testing site open to search engines.
- Deleting old product pages that still earn visits.
- Changing addresses without a good reason.

## Who this service is for

A store owner moving from one platform to another needs this most. So does a seller who plans a redesign that changes page addresses, or a business merging two stores into one. A brand that is renaming its domain must also map every address carefully.

It also suits a store with a developer who is skilled at building but has not handled search before.

## What we need from you

Send the old store address, the new store address or staging link, and your planned launch date. Add us as a viewer on Search Console and analytics so we can see which pages bring visits. Tell us who your developer is so we can work with them. We never need your passwords, and any access is given as a collaborator, staff or developer user where the platform supports it.
